---
applyTo: "src/app/**/*.ts,src/app/**/*.html,src/**/*.css"
---

For Angular UI changes, follow [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) and load the project skill that matches the task:
- Use `.agents/skills/riudicc-angular-ui/SKILL.md` to build or refactor screens and components.
- Use `.agents/skills/riudicc-ui-review/SKILL.md` to inspect or improve an existing screen.

Use Angular 19 standalone patterns, shared components, Tailwind CSS 4, DaisyUI 5, and the configured theme. Include responsive behavior, accessible labels and focus states, and loading, empty, validation, and error states where relevant.
